notes:
A mirror used for grooming and applying makeup. Composed of ⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧ (makeup, cosmetics) + {鏡|きょう} (mirror). Ranges from small portable hand mirrors to large wall-mounted mirrors in bathrooms and dressing rooms.
